newsitem.title: USA: Kohl's officers plan to sell 700,000 shrs.
newsitem.headline: Kohl's officers plan to sell 700,000 shrs.

text.p: Kohl's Corp said on Thursday that three of its senior officers informed the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission of their intention to sell about 700,000 shares, or five percent of their combined holdings.
The officials are William Kellogg, chairman and chief executive officer; Jay Baker, president, and John Herma, chief operating officer.
Collectively, they own about 13.6 million shares, including shares held by family trusts, and have vested options to buy an additional aggregate of 500,000 shares.
The executives intend to continue to own a significant number of shares of Kohl's, the company said in a SEC filing.
The aggregate ownership, including vested option shares, of directors and executive officers of Kohl's as a group (13 individuals) represents about 21 percent of the outstanding stock.
After the sale of the 700,000 shares, the group will own about 20 percent of the company.
Management said it did not expect the group's ownership to dip below 15 percent over the next five years.
